temporal_sampling: deterministic near-equal allocation within every dataset, pool, and pair kind
video_contribution_balancing: greedily select from the currently least-represented eligible video with seeded SHA-256 tie breaking
pair_scope: within one selected video and one locked dataset pool only
normalized_camera_displacement_definitio: Euclidean frame-to-frame camera translation divided by the mean camera-to-world-origin distance at the two frames
fixed_camera_roundoff_rule: when translation is below 1e-12 scene units and relative rotation is below 1e-5 degrees, record both as structural zero motion
shortfall_action: fail without changing any cutoff, quota, or locked pool
